about: Jobs found by Claude's weekly browser sweep

items.title: Assistant Dockmaster - Deep Point Marina
items.snippet: Full-time dock crew at the Bald Head Island ferry marina (85 slips, may cover the 170-slip BHI marina). Asks for public-facing + marina experience, which matches his 8 seasons. Needs an NC driver licence.

items.title: Marine Construction Crew Member
items.snippet: Marine construction crew (docks, piers, bulkheads from barges) between Georgetown and Charleston, $18–35/hr. Work on the water with real pay; his boat handling helps.

items.title: Deckhand
items.snippet: Deckhand on a Miami private/event charter yacht (day boat, not live-aboard). Passenger-vessel sea time counts toward a USCG captain licence. Pay not listed. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Sales Development Representative
items.snippet: Remote entry-level SDR selling construction-site software (Hilti company). A field/trades product suits his hands-on background. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Sales Development Representative, High Growth B2B SaaS (Remote)
items.snippet: Remote SDR, $55–60k base, B2B SaaS. Entry-level; his Best Buy/Meta demo work is the pitch. Posted in the last 7 days.

items.title: Sales Development Representative -- Remote Position

items.title: Detailer

items.snippet: Passenger ferry deck crew: lines, boarding, watch standing, steering under the master. No USCG licence required; 1 yr public-facing work, First Aid/CPR, drug test, NC driver licence.

items.title: Event Stagehand - Myrtle Beach
items.snippet: On-call W-2 crew for concerts and festivals around Myrtle Beach. No experience required, 18+, own transport. Shifts as events come up, so he can start right away. Listing says closing soon.

items.title: Part Time Promotional Specialist - Bacardi
items.snippet: Part-time brand promo at local events and bars. Brand-ambassador experience preferred, which matches his 2020 Companies/ActionLink work. Closing soon.

items.title: Zipfizz Brand Ambassador - Weekend Demo
items.snippet: Weekend product demos inside Costco, up to $35/hr with commission, weekly pay, paid training, no experience required. Closing soon.

items.title: Sales Development Representative

items.title: Bellperson & Valet (Part-time) - Ocean 22
items.snippet: Valet/bell at Ocean 22 resort, daily pay, benefits day one. Needs 6 months customer service (he has valet + brand ambassador) and manual-transmission driving.

items.title: Marketing and Event Coordinator
items.snippet: Entry-level full-time role running community events, local partnerships and social media. Wants 1 yr promotional experience (his brand ambassador work fits). Apply with resume + why, mention something from their website.
